notes.title: Puzzzle Roadmap
notes.content:
Okay let's begin. For anyone wondering why yet another roadmap is being released, please check out the community post before this one which explained where I have been all this time.

First of all, Puzzzle is being, sort of, reborn. We are currently at [b]Version 0.1[/b]. The game will go through many iterations and phases before we can get to Version 1.0.

[h1]Phase One:[/h1]
[h3]August --- December[/h3]

 | | | Bug Fixes
 | | | New SFX
 | | | New Background Music
 | | | New UI
 | | | Massive gameplay overhaul - more "puzzle-like elements"
 | | | 100 new levels
 | | | "Secret Levels"
 | | | Menu overhaul - Main Menu, Settings Menu, Pause Menu, Updated credits
 | | | Animation overhaul
 | | | New trailer
 | | | Resolution bug fixes
 | | | Removal of facemask :(

End Result: [b]Version 0.4[/b]

[h1]Phase Two:[/h1]
[h3]January (2022) --- May[/h3]

 | | | Introduction of Secret Saturday
 | | | 200 more levels
 | | | Multiple background music tracks
 | | | More "Secret Levels"
 | | | Performance fixes
 | | | Epic Games Store
 | | | DLC??????
 | | | Plus a lot of epic stuff...

End Result: [b]Version 0.8[/b]

[h1]Phase Three?[/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

-Pause menu improved (character freezes)
-Added Main Menu feature (you can remove the UI and press 'Escape' to go back)
-Added progress bar for the game (Settings menu -> bottom left button)
-Level 21 end trigger fixed
-Level 20 collider fixed (you can no longer jump out of the map)
-Riding horizontal moving platforms properly (NOTE: vertical moving platforms not yet properly integrated)
- Performance patches
-Level 101 (cool)




-Thanks for reading! If there are any issues, just comment on this post!

-Stephen Walton, "dev"
